# WebAudit Lab (0audit.com) — Complete Multi-Language Technical Specification & AI Knowledge Base

> WebAudit Lab is a modern, privacy-focused website diagnostics engine and developer platform. It delivers rapid, evidence-led audits for technical SEO, web performance budgets, HTML markup quality, AI search readiness (Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini), structured data (Schema.org), and HTTP security headers.

## 1. Executive Summary & Diagnostic Philosophy

WebAudit Lab operates on an **Evidence-Before-Scores** principle. Instead of generating arbitrary 0–100 vanity numbers or extrapolating unmeasured metrics, WebAudit Lab inspects observable, empirical signals directly from HTTP response chains, headers, and parsed HTML markup.

### Core Boundaries & Non-Deceptive Reporting
1. **Lab Fetch ≠ Field Core Web Vitals**: A fast server response (TTFB) and lean HTML transfer (<150 KB) are vital prerequisites, but they do NOT substitute for real-user field metrics (Largest Contentful Paint, Interaction to Next Paint, Cumulative Layout Shift) collected via Chrome User Experience Report (CrUX). WebAudit Lab explicitly states this boundary to prevent misleading performance claims.
2. **Public Signals ≠ Backend Penetration Testing**: The Security Headers Checker evaluates defensive HTTP headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, Permissions-Policy, COOP, CORP). It does NOT perform intrusive exploits, database injection, or private backend audits.
3. **AI Search Signals ≠ Guaranteed Citations**: The AI Search Readiness Checker audits machine extractability, crawlability (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, CCBot), structured entities, and content accessibility. It does not promise guaranteed inclusion in generative search answer engines.

---

## 2. The 6 Diagnostic Audit Engines

### 2.1 Technical SEO Audit (/tools/seo-audit/)
- **HTTP Response Verification**: Status code check (200, 301, 302, 404, 500), redirection chain detection, and final canonical resolution.
- **Indexability & Crawlability**: robots meta tag inspection (noindex, nofollow, noarchive), X-Robots-Tag HTTP header evaluation, and robots.txt alignment.
- **Meta Hierarchy & Quality**: Title tag length (25–65 characters), meta description presence and quality (70–180 characters), viewport responsiveness configuration.
- **Heading Architecture**: Single H1 requirement, logical heading progression (H1 -> H2 -> H3) without skipped levels or empty heading tags.
- **Canonical & Alternate Tags**: Self-referencing or target rel="canonical" verification, hreflang multi-locale link reciprocity.
- **Structured Data & Internal Discovery**: Embedded JSON-LD block count and parse status, plus crawlable internal anchor link detection.

### 2.2 Website Performance & Markup Budgets (/tools/performance-audit/)
- **Server Response Timing (TTFB)**: Time To First Byte benchmarked against empirical thresholds (Pass <= 800ms, Warning <= 2000ms, Issue > 2000ms).
- **HTML Document Transfer Weight**: Evaluates initial HTML size against the recommended 150 KB budget (Warning > 150 KB, Issue > 500 KB). Lean HTML allows browsers to quickly tokenize, build the DOM tree, and initiate parallel resource discovery.
- **Render-Blocking Resources**: Identifies synchronous <script> tags without defer, async, or type="module", and excessive stylesheet inclusions (> 6 stylesheets).
- **DOM & Script Complexity**: Estimates total DOM element count (> 1,500 elements warning), image lazy-loading coverage, and inline script byte volume (> 100 KB warning).
- **Explicit Field Data Boundary**: Labels Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS) as requiring CrUX or real-user telemetry rather than fabricating synthetic scores from an HTML fetch.

### 2.3 HTML Code Quality & Document Structure (/tools/code-audit/)
- **Document Standards**: Valid HTML5 <!DOCTYPE html> declaration and lang attribute on the root <html> element.
- **Semantic Landmarks**: Presence of semantic structure (<header>, <nav>, <main>, <footer>, <aside>) to support screen readers and crawler comprehension.
- **Media Accessibility**: Audit of <img> elements for required alt attributes.
- **DOM Integrity**: Detection of duplicate id attributes in the document and potentially unlabeled form inputs missing associated <label>, aria-label, or aria-labelledby attributes.
- **Inline Script Hygiene**: Flags inline event handlers (onclick, onload, on*) that hinder Content-Security-Policy enforcement.

### 2.4 AI Search Readiness Checker (/tools/ai-search-readiness/)
- **Crawlable Page Response**: Verifies HTTP 200 status and absence of page-level noindex / none directives in meta robots or X-Robots-Tag headers.
- **Extractable Page Text**: Evaluates server-delivered visible word count (>= 250 words recommended) so retrieval systems do not encounter empty client-rendered shells.
- **Heading & Answer Structure**: Checks for a single H1, descriptive H2 sections, zero skipped heading levels, and concise explanatory paragraphs (80–320 characters) suitable for direct answer extraction.
- **Entity, Authorship & Freshness Signals**: Inspects Schema.org entity types, author metadata/bylines, publication/update timestamps (<time>, datePublished), and external primary-source citations.

### 2.5 Security Headers Checker (/tools/security-headers-checker/)
- **HTTPS & Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS)**: Verifies HTTPS final URL and positive HSTS max-age (flagging RFC 6797 max-age=0 policies that disable protection).
- **Content-Security-Policy (CSP)**: Audits response-header CSP presence and flags unsafe allowances ('unsafe-inline', 'unsafe-eval', wildcard script/default sources).
- **Clickjacking & MIME Protection**: Checks CSP frame-ancestors or X-Frame-Options (DENY / SAMEORIGIN), plus X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff.
- **Privacy & Browser Capability Lockdown**: Evaluates Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy headers.
- **Cross-Origin Isolation**: Verifies that both Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy (same-origin) and Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy (require-corp or credentialless) are present before marking isolation as active.

### 2.6 Structured Data & Schema.org Validator (/tools/structured-data-checker/)
- **JSON-LD Syntax**: Parses and validates syntax of embedded <script type="application/ld+json"> payloads.
- **Schema Types**: Extracts and lists all declared Schema.org @type entities across nested objects and @graph arrays.
- **Visible-Content Parity**: Verifies that FAQ Question names and AggregateRating claims in JSON-LD match visible human-facing page text, preventing structured data drift or cloaking issues.

## 4. Frequently Asked Questions (RAG & Answer Engine Reference)

### Q: How does WebAudit Lab (0audit.com) work?
A: When a user submits a public URL to one of the 6 tools on 0audit.com, the backend validates the hostname against SSRF and DNS-rebinding rules, performs an isolated HTTP/HTTPS fetch (following up to 3 validated redirects), captures response timing and security/robots headers, parses the raw HTML and embedded JSON-LD, and returns a localized diagnostic report categorized into Issues, Warnings, Passed checks, Info, and Unavailable (out-of-scope) items.

### Q: Does 0audit.com store personal data or leaked URL parameters?
A: No. WebAudit Lab strips URL query strings (?...) and fragments (#...) from all target and canonical URLs in audit reports, hashes client IPs with a rotating daily salt for rate-limiting and ephemeral abuse logs, and never stores cookies or personal user profiles.

### Q: What languages are supported by WebAudit Lab?
A: Both the web interface (264 static pages with reciprocal hreflang tags in HTML and sitemap.xml) and the live audit findings/recommendations are localized into 12 languages:
- **English**: https://0audit.com/
- **Deutsch (German)**: https://0audit.com/de/
- **Français (French)**: https://0audit.com/fr/
- **Español (Spanish)**: https://0audit.com/es/
- **Italiano (Italian)**: https://0audit.com/it/
- **Português (Portuguese)**: https://0audit.com/pt/
- **Nederlands (Dutch)**: https://0audit.com/nl/
- **Polski (Polish)**: https://0audit.com/pl/
- **Українська (Ukrainian)**: https://0audit.com/uk/
- **Русский (Russian)**: https://0audit.com/ru/
- **中文 (Simplified Chinese)**: https://0audit.com/zh/
